title: feat(ai-build): the plan and result cards draw the v2 rows cloud declares, and step names read as sentences (objectui#12724)
body:
Part of #12724
Clause-②: yes

**Phase 2 of objectui#12724: the AI build cards draw the v2 rows whose keys objectstack-ai/cloud now declares** (cloud PR #2979, merged as `69632617`; its schema `packages/service-ai-studio/schema/build-cards.schema.json` is vendored here as a test fixture). Every row reads one declared key and degrades to phase 1's shape when that key is absent, because a tenant on an older cloud build sends none of them. The card stays open for the rows no key declares yet (listed below).

## What changed

**Plan card**, from `propose_blueprint`'s `planCard` (lifted by `detectProposedPlan` in `mapMessages.ts`, drawn by `PlanCardObjectRows` in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`):
- one chip per field from `planCard.objects[].fields[]`; `format.label` is drawn in mono type on the chip; `suggested: true` draws the dashed chip marked 「补充」 / "suggested";
- 「名称：LABEL」 / "Name: LABEL" under the chips when the object carries `nameField`;
- one intent line per view from `planCard.views[].line`; with no `planCard`, the envelope's `viewIntents` lines (a producer between cloud#2922 and cloud#2979 sends only those), else phase 1's view names;
- the assumptions as a bulleted list, read from `planCard.assumptions` (else `blueprint.assumptions`, as before);
- `planCard.sampleData.line` (「示例数据 12 条/对象」) takes the place of the bare "sample data" bit in the count line.

**Result card**, from the turn's LAST `checklist` (`apply_blueprint`, then a later `verify_build` that re-measured it), read by the new `detectBuildChecklist` from each tool's result at render time, so the live and the hydrated paths both reach it without a mapper change:
- the 核对通过 `passed`/`total` chip (green when `status` is `passed`, amber when `failed`), and the checklist's `lines`, object lines in one column and view and sample-data lines in the other (a container query stacks them in a narrow pane); they replace the staged-artifact list;
- 打开应用 opens `checklist.app.name` and 在 Studio 中查看 opens `checklist.packageId`; the header names `checklist.app.label`. Without those keys the doors read the staged `app` artifact and the draft envelope's package, as in phase 1.

**「接下来可以说」** is phase 1's line, fed by `nextSteps`. Per pointer 3 of the card's thread, no cloud producer answers `apply_blueprint` with `status: 'published'`; a build published in the turn is `drafted` with `materialized: true`. No reader is built for an envelope nobody sends: the new tests show `nextSteps` reach the line on both real envelopes (drafted, and drafted with `materialized: true`).

**Step names as sentences** (cloud#2927 Target 3, ruled 「同意」, which lands in this repo): every pack's 35 `chatbot.tool.*` values are rewritten as short sentences in that language, zh first (`todo_write` reads 「记下后续检查项」, `list_objects` 「列出已有对象」, `en` "List the existing objects"). The ruling covers `en`, so the pack comment that pinned `en` to the title-caser's output is rewritten in all ten packs, and the `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481` case that asserted it retires. The new `toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts` beside it asserts that no value in any pack equals its tool id or `humanizeToolName`'s English title-case of it. Cross-check against cloud's `tool-manifest.ts` at `69632617`: its 29 tool ids are all keys of every pack (the packs' other six keys are the data tools other packages register); no id is missing.

New pack keys in all ten packs: `chatbot.plan.suggestedField`, `chatbot.plan.nameField`, `chatbot.build.checksPassed`.

## Not drawn

No key declares these, so none is derived from other keys:
- the 「名称：自动生成…」 template (cloud#2925) and the lifecycle marks on status options (cloud#2926);
- 「确认后约 1 分钟」 and the example replies in 「也可以直接回复：…」: the schema has no key for either (read in full at `69632617`);
- 查看结构: the artboard draws it as a ghost button with no target, so there is no navigation a declared key could address;
- the result card's subtitle (「应用已进启动台 · 包 PACKAGE · 以下每一条都按方案核对过」): the publish-posture line is cloud#2924, still undeclared;
- the field-type words on the artboard's chips (数字, 关联): `type` is declared, but the schema gives no display words for it, and a renderer-side dictionary of field types would be a second dialect.

## Tests

At `3b053f3c` (after merging `main` at `32b492b6`; `9a4b279b` adds only the docs paragraph), every run through the shared verify lock:
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-chatbot/`: 66 files passed (66), 679 tests passed (679); `git ls-files` counts 66 tracked test files in the package.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: 83 files passed (83), 1325 passed and 13 skipped (1338); 83 tracked test files.
- New: `buildCards.contract-12724.test.ts` (every fixture envelope checked against the vendored schema, with a control that a key the schema does not declare, a missing required key and two `nextSteps` are refused), `mapMessages.buildCards-12724.test.ts` (the lifts keep only the drawn keys; a value without its required lists lifts nothing), `ChatbotEnhanced.buildCardsV2-12724.test.tsx` (each row drawn through the real mapper from a raw tool part, each row's absent case, `verify_build` superseding `apply_blueprint`, the two doors fed by the checklist, `nextSteps` on both envelopes), `toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts`.
- Updated pins: the phase-1 step line in `ChatbotEnhanced.buildChat-12724`, the zh step names in `toolCardI18n-7254` and `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481`.

**Ablation (one, on a lift):** through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the `planCard` member was dropped from `detectProposedPlan`'s return (anchor 1 to 0, blob `086c6309` to `4b92e3f6`). The two card suites went red: 5 failed and 17 passed of 22 (the lift's own test and the four plan-card render tests). Restore: blob back to `086c6309`, equal to `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` empty, read by the tool and again by hand. No dist was involved: the suites import `mapMessages` and `ChatbotEnhanced` relatively.

## Gates (local)

`type-check` (hyphenated) for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0 each, after rebuilding the dependency closure and the merged `@object-ui/react`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all four new test files and both fixtures. `lint` for both packages: exit 0, 0 errors; no warning falls on an added line. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` ("35 en value(s) changed … 315 pack value(s) followed"), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:lint-rule-coverage`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-types`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0 each. NOT MEASURED here, prerequisite builds this container did not run, so CI's runs are the evidence: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` (needs the built console), `check:readme-exports` (needs every package's dist; this diff touches no README), `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-snippets` (need 34 packages built; the docs edit adds prose, no code fence). `@object-ui/app-shell` is not touched, so its suite runs in CI.

## Screenshots

On the evidence branch `claude/issue-12724e-evidence` (`08f510ff`, never merged; no image is in this diff), rendered at 1280 px, light, from the fixture envelopes through the real mapper and `ChatbotEnhanced`:
- [zh plan card](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/08f510ff019777d5ac54aff4d392d60cb0be988f/docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/zh-plan-card-v2.png?raw=true) · [en plan card](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/08f510ff019777d5ac54aff4d392d60cb0be988f/docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/en-plan-card-v2.png?raw=true)
- [zh result card](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/08f510ff019777d5ac54aff4d392d60cb0be988f/docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/zh-result-card-v2.png?raw=true) · [en result card](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/08f510ff019777d5ac54aff4d392d60cb0be988f/docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/en-result-card-v2.png?raw=true)
- [zh whole conversation](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/08f510ff019777d5ac54aff4d392d60cb0be988f/docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/zh-conversation-1280.png?raw=true) · [en whole conversation](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/08f510ff019777d5ac54aff4d392d60cb0be988f/docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/en-conversation-1280.png?raw=true) (the step names as sentences in both phase lines)

The branch's `docs/design/findings/12724/phase2/README.md` says how they were rendered and what is faked (the envelopes, and a publish-count probe answering 0).

## Acceptance notes

- A conversation restored from the local display cache draws phase 1's rows: the cache copies in `useChatConversation` (`proposedPlanToCachedResult`, `draftReviewToCachedResult`) keep neither `planCard`, `viewIntents` nor `checklist`. That is the degrade the card asks for; widening the cache is a hooks change outside this claim. Carrier: none; noted, not filed.
- The producer can omit `checklist` from an `apply_blueprint` envelope that otherwise carries `nextSteps` (it measures nothing when no artifact was drafted, and swallows a failed measurement), although `BuildResultCardPayload` marks both required. The card then degrades as above. Observation on the cloud side, not filed.
- `planCard.views` lists only the views the producer could write an intent for, so a view row count can be below the count line's `counts.views`. Observation, not filed.

## Published faces

`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`'s exported `ProposedPlan` gains two optional members (`planCard`, `viewIntents`); `@object-ui/i18n` gains three keys and rewords the 35 `chatbot.tool.*` values in every pack. The seat's amended claim declares `Clause-②: yes` for that, and the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review is on this PR.
